preauthored_theme_gates.criterion: A physical CRT and VHS playback context contain an obsolete monochrome warehouse recording; at least one unmistakable tape/scan artifact belongs visibly inside the monitor image.
preauthored_theme_gates.pass_boundary: A vintage color grade alone fails.
preauthored_theme_gates.evidence: The physical CRT occupies the right side, with PAUSE and a time counter in its monochrome warehouse image. Fine screen lines and one lower white tracking break stay within the glass. A separate VHS cassette and playback deck are visible below.

preauthored_theme_gates.criterion: Inside the monitor, an upright wrapped cargo form has an unmistakably human-shaped head-and-shoulder silhouette among ordinary low crates, making the recorded image troubling.
preauthored_theme_gates.pass_boundary: A normal crate, ordinary standing worker, or hidden silhouette fails.
preauthored_theme_gates.evidence: The recording contains an upright stretch-wrapped form with a tied top, distinct head and broad human-like shoulders, among low wooden crates; a dark head recess faces the surveillance viewpoint. Its 23 tag is large and legible.

preauthored_theme_gates.criterion: The paper shipment record and recorded cargo are visibly linked through the same large 23 identifier, and the paper identifies a crate while the recorded shape is human-like.
preauthored_theme_gates.pass_boundary: If the identifiers or paper category are partial/unreadable, the full mismatch is unproven.
preauthored_theme_gates.evidence: The paper ledger visibly lists reference 23 with description CRATE, while the CRT form bears a matching large 23 tag and human-shaped contours. The mismatch is readable without needing the finger to land correctly.

preauthored_theme_gates.criterion: The reference-guided woman is visibly investigating the ledger and turning attention toward the CRT with interrupted writing, linking her response to the record.
preauthored_theme_gates.pass_boundary: An isolated portrait with unrelated retro props fails.
preauthored_theme_gates.evidence: The woman leans over a receiving ledger, holds a pen in one hand and keeps the other on the page; her eyes are directed toward the CRT. This supports a paused work comparison as a still-frame reading. Actual temporal interruption cannot be proven. The fine hand-row mismatch is recorded separately as a failure.

preauthored_theme_gates.criterion: The fictional subject retains visibly comparable face and short dark bob with wispy bangs from the supplied portrait at a useful review scale.
preauthored_theme_gates.pass_boundary: This measures appearance guidance only and establishes no real identity.
preauthored_theme_gates.evidence: The saved photograph retains a short dark bob, wispy bangs, comparable eyes, nose and lips, and similar facial proportions to the supplied portrait at a large review scale. This is appearance guidance, not identity proof.

material_action_mismatch.evidence: At native scale the left index fingertip lands at the QTY header/first-row area, above row 23. The right-hand pen nib touches a blank area above the listed rows. The two contacts therefore do not realize a finger beside 23 / CRATE with a pen hovering above that same row.

overall_reason: The preauthored theme gates are visible, but the intended contact/target geometry fails. No whole-case pass is claimed by averaging the genre success with the action mismatch.
limitations: A still image does not establish elapsed time, actual videotape provenance, supernatural causation or the wrapped form's life/death/identity.
No same-scene baseline image or controlled ablation was generated, so this is not proof that retrieval improved image quality.
Source A001 informs physical carrier clarity; the central shipment mismatch and human-shaped recording were independently authored before retrieval.
